note: Phillips County, AR has no published zoning district polygon service. Helena-West Helena, the county seat and only city with zoning found, publishes its Official Zoning Map only as a PDF (hwh.ar.gov/s/ZoningMap.pdf). The county does not appear to zone unincorporated land. The state GIS Office Planning_Cadastre services hold parcels and PLSS layers only, no zoning. Commercial zoning sites (zoneomics) are subscription-based and not official. Other towns (Marvell, Elaine, Lake View) show no zoning GIS.
